item.title: Terrebonne Parish, Louisiana Offshore Oil Port address offshore oil spill
item.description: There was an oil spill that occurred offshore involving the Louisiana Offshore Oil Port (LOOP) on Thursday, Feb. 27, according to the Terrebonne Parish Consolidated Government.

item.title: Water main break reported in Central City
item.description: Crews with the New Orleans Sewerage and Water Board are on the scene of a possible water main break in Central City.

item.title: Crews respond to large woods fire in Angie
item.description: Crews are responding to a woods fire in Angie on Wednesday, March 4.

item.title: Slidell Police corrections officer arrested, accused of attempting to lure a minor to park: FBI
item.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigations arrested a Slidell Corrections Officer who is accused of crimes against a minor, according to Chief Daniel Seuzeneau.

item.title: Proposed bill would require new Louisiana residences to have a fortified roof
item.description: Chair of the Senate Insurance Committee, Kirk Talbot, is planning on introducing a proactive measure in Senate Bill 147, which would require new residential construction to have a fortified roof.

item.title: New Orleans Book festival to be held at Tulane University
item.description: The fifth annual New Orleans Book Festival at Tulane University will be held March 12 through March 15.

item.title: New Orleans actor in 'Sinners' talks about his fight with Michael B. Jordan
item.description: Born and raised in New Orleans, actor Justin William Davis who attended the University of New Orleans and Southeastern University, stars in "Sinners," which is up for a record-breaking 16 Oscars. WGNO's Kenny Lopez sat down with Justin William Davis to talk about his role in "Sinners" and his fight scene with Michael B. Jordan.

item.title: Covington resident stranded in Qatar, reaching out for government assistance
item.description: What was supposed to be a work trip turned into a nightmare for Covington resident Bobby Piner. He's currently stranded thousands of miles away due to conflict in the Middle East.
